question: I just accepted a job offer but I'm pregnant and haven't told them. Do I have to disclose it, and will I get any maternity leave if I start in October?
private_situation: Elena Voss accepted a Senior Project Architect offer at Quarry Lane Architects starting October 19 with a 90-day probation while 14 weeks pregnant (due March 19, 2027) and has not told the employer.
answer_rubric: States there is no legal duty to disclose pregnancy and that pregnancy discrimination is prohibited (Pregnancy Discrimination Act, Pregnant Workers Fairness Act)
Explains FMLA requires 12 months of service so it will likely not apply, and mentions state paid leave or employer policy as alternatives
Covers probation period risks and documenting communications
Gives practical advice on when and how to tell the employer and to review the benefits or handbook
